top_signals.title: India's Central Bank Hikes Repo Rate By 25 Bps
top_signals.summary: RBI raised interest rates for the first time in nearly four years. Governor Sanjay Malhotra says given the current economic scenario,  rate hikes are off the table in the near-term. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: MS Capital CEO on China Markets, Investment Strategy
top_signals.summary: Kate Zhang, CEO at hedge fund MS Capital, discusses the investment opportunities in China's equity markets and the rising demand from global investors for Chinese quants. She speaks with Yvonne Man and Avril Hong on Bloomberg: The China Show. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Sumo’s officiating cohort is a world of its own
top_signals.summary: Gyōji inhabit a world every bit as steeped in tradition as that of the wrestlers they officiate.
